name: Mary Gardiner Brainard
bio: Mary Gardiner Brainard (1837–1905) was born in New London, Connecticut, the niece of the poet John Gardiner Calkins Brainard.
Her poem "Not Knowing" first appeared in The Congregationalist in 1869 and was later set to music as a hymn.
